headline: The list lacks a way to prove what P&I changes

sub: Without it, SoW and CM3 gains cannot be attributed to the programme

bullets.text: North Star driver tree and forecast
sub: Enrolment x activation x level-up rate minus drops: is 125k reachable?

bullets.text: Analysis of level volatility, not just data quality
sub: How much of the 22.6k drops is balance movement, not behaviour

bullets.text: AI compliance: GDPR and the AI Act
sub: Banker notes, Brain and personas need a legal basis before scale

annotation: I would add the first three to P&I's scope now; compliance runs alongside Brain v1.
source: Source: case study brief (Nov 2026); P&I proposal.
notes: Four things I would add. First and most important: a way to prove impact. Holdout groups for every campaign and list. Without that, we will never convince Finance.
Second, a driver tree that shows whether 125k is reachable and which lever gets us there.
Third, the list has data quality and new rules, but not the question in between: how much of the drops is pure balance movement. That is the evidence the council needs.
Fourth, AI compliance. Banker notes in particular are personal data.
